items.quote: Abishai son of Zeruiah came to David’s rescue; he struck the Philistine down and killed him.
items.contrast: Abishai, the rescuer and killer, versus David, the exhausted man whom the Philistine intended to kill.
items.reason: David is a plausible alternative because he went to fight the Philistines, but the passage explicitly assigns the killing to Abishai.
